samples.name: 01-desktop-sequence
samples.title: Desktop reading and keyboard sequence
samples.review_note: Reading, low typing, sparse nearby key presses, another reading pause and a short correction. Keyboard-directed gaze lasts longer than requested; screen response is unverified.

samples.name: 02-mouse-keyboard-sequence
samples.title: Mouse and keyboard sequence
samples.review_note: Reading and mouse movement, a continuous transfer to brief typing, then a return to mouse use. Gaze checks are somewhat frequent during typing; a second typing burst was not achieved.

samples.name: 03-laptop-sequence
samples.title: Laptop reading and typing sequence
samples.review_note: Nine-second selection: reading, low typing, pause, a local hand reposition and return to keys. Mid-sequence fingers are somewhat stiff. Full 15-second take rejected for later hand hovering; a clean trackpad scroll was not achieved.
